name: Algebraic Matrix Embedding Obfuscation
description: We embed the symmetric constraint $h_u \neq h_v$ into the determinant of a $3 \times 3$ matrix that heavily incorporates the edge's specific endpoints $u$ and $v$. By equating this determinant to a function of $u$ and $v$ ($3uv$), the condition algebraically simplifies to $h_u h_v = 2$, which is exactly $h_u \neq h_v$. This defeats models because the local constraint appears strongly asymmetric and dependent on global edge properties, preventing them from recognizing the universal symmetry that allows reduction to 2-coloring.
